Skill Icons

Every player skill's icon, as the game draws it. A picture you want changed: edit that skill's row in docs/data/skill_icons.csv — ICON is any name from game-icons.net (the end of the icon's address), SCHOOL one of the colours below — or just say which one. Passives are drawn dimmer than skills you press.

steel — Physical / weaponearth — Defence / tankwind — Speed / evasionblood — Blood / crit / demonfire — Firefrost — Froststorm — Lightning / shockarcane — Arcane / magicmind — Mana / spiritholy — Holy / healinglife — Life / regenerationnature — Nature / elfpoison — Poisonshadow — Shadow / curse / stealthsound — Song / harmonywhisp — Whispsigil — Sigilneutral — Neutralsocial — Social / party / chatcommon — Item: Commonuncommon — Item: Uncommonrare — Item: Rareepic — Item: Epiclegendary — Item: Legendarymythic — Item: Mythic
